title: The 4th lord is dignified or in a kendra or trikona

text.en: The lord of the 4th house, the house of the mother, is dignified or well placed, traditionally a support for the mother's welfare.
text.impact: Your mother's wellbeing has good support in your chart, and the bond with her tends to be a steady one.
